theorems.name: Submission.lpf_lli_countable_lipschitz_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ∃ (O : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (K : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ i, O i ∧ ∀ i, LipschitzOnWith (K i) f (O i ∩ U)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
